# testdata

Sample PDFs used by the workbench, `detect:smoke`, and
`scripts/verify-testdata.mjs`.

## Open-source samples (from Mozilla pdf.js)

All three come from the [Mozilla pdf.js repository](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js)
(`test/pdfs/`), which is licensed under the **Apache License 2.0**:

| File | Source | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tracemonkey.pdf` | https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/test/pdfs/tracemonkey.pdf | The pdf.js demo document — a real multi-page article with text and images; the primary "real world" sample. |
| `basicapi.pdf` | https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/test/pdfs/basicapi.pdf | Text-heavy multi-page document with a rich selectable text layer (the pdf.js API docs sample). |
| `XiaoBiaoSong.pdf` | https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/test/pdfs/XiaoBiaoSong.pdf | CJK font specimen — exercises the text layer's approximated CJK metrics (see the plugin README's known limitations). |

pdf.js's license: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/LICENSE.

## Synthetic fixtures (generated)

| File | Generated by | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `two-pages.pdf` / `three-pages.pdf` | `pnpm testdata` (`scripts/make-testdata.mjs`) | Hand-built, uncompressed PDFs with visible `/Type /Page` objects — the fixture for the plugin's best-effort page-count scan and the multi-page rendering path. |
| `fake.pdf` | `pnpm testdata` | Negative fixture: a `.pdf`-named text file that `detect` must reject (`%PDF-` magic missing). |
